turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be brief. Why was a zero entered on Owen's essay, and why did I find out from him instead of you?
I didn't come to be thanked, Hale. I asked you a question. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Seventeen. He lives at home, so he's not an independent student, and I'm entitled to see his whole record. Now, who decided on the zero?
A grocery store. What does that have to do with the zero, Hale? You still haven't told me who decided.
When did his dad move out?
That's not your business, Hale, and it's not in your policy. I'm writing down that you asked. Who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
And what day was the zero entered?
You entered it, Hale. Tuesday, November 3, and nobody called me before it went in. Your own procedure, 4.2, says someone does, so who decided?
What do you know about his essay so far?
That a software checker flagged it and a zero followed. That's all I've been given, Hale. What else do you have?
